notes.title: Don't Turn Back Major Update 1
notes.content:
Heyo Everyone!  

We are super excited to release our first major patch. We've been working diligently to address all the reported bugs and glitches in the game (we are ashamed of the solid white cube in the door).  

 With that being said....

What's New?
Added new cutscenes to progress the story.

Added more voice lines.
What's Fixed?
Improved overall performance for lower-end hardware.

Improved the overall atmosphere.

Removed the "white cube" from the hallway.

Fixed the invisible wall blocking the player from entering the hallway.
What's Broken?
Missing textures in the map.

Slight chance the game's exe file isn't found in the install directory.

The office door leading to the next section is glitched shut.

notes.title: Don't Turn Back Minor Update 1
notes.content:
Heyo Everyone! 

We fixed some problems and are also working diligently on our first major patch, but before that, here is just a minor patch. What's New?
- Voice lines have been added to the game.

Music has been added to the game (no more awkward silence).

The save system has now been implemented (we are aware of some bugs with it, and they will be fixed in the upcoming major patch).


What's Changed?
System Performance has been improved, and we are continuing to find optimizations.

Fixed certain tutorial sections that didn't appear to the player.

Removed unnecessary inputs from the input list in the settings.

Changed the intro cinematic slightly at the beginning.


Thank you very much to everyone who wishlisted and purchased Don't Turn Back. We didn't expect a ton of people to put a lot of faith in our little game, but we are glad you did. We are working hard to give you the vision of Don't Turn Back that we see, and we won't stop till that happens. 

Thank you. :-)
